body:
Use Param and typed predicates for runtime query values; reserve Literal/raw fragments and raw schema type/default text for authored SQL. For DDL, let inline rendering call the dialect literal writer and propagate refusal. This retains argument binding for query data and avoids pretending every SQL context supports placeholders.

title: Separate values from authored SQL
